svg.title: Risk ladder: what can move markets from here
svg.desc: A four-step risk ladder showing Hormuz shipping disruption as the highest immediate risk, followed by US inflation and Fed policy, Nigerian fuel and foreign-exchange transmission, and AI valuation risk.
